notes: Planning/architecture layer between seo-01 (keyword-targets@1) and seo-02 (serp-briefs). Deterministic + offline: turns the flat keyword list into a hub-and-spoke + funnel content map (clusters, funnel tags, internal-link graph, cannibalization guards, prioritized build queue) as content-map@1. No network, no API keys; pure function of the upstream artifact + the skill config. seo-02/04/05 consume the build queue, link graph, and URL plan.
